result.instructions: Tools for Skedda, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which spaces are bookable at our venue?"; "Show every booking in the meeting rooms for next week."; "Which bookings were changed since yesterday?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Skedda data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run skedda_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run skedda_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run skedda_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. skedda_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: skedda_list_assets
tools.title: List assets
tools.description: List the venue's assets: bookable spaces, individual space assignments and add-ons. Filter by category. Returns one page with paging.cursor. Skedda API: GET /api/v1/assets.

category.description: bookable = spaces booked for a period; assigned = spaces held by one user; addOn = extras booked with a space.

cursor.description: paging.cursor of the previous page. Keep every other parameter unchanged.

expand.description: Comma-separated paths to return in full instead of ids, e.g. assignedTo. Up to 3 fields; nest with dots.

tools.name: skedda_list_booking_occurrences
tools.title: List booking occurrences
tools.description: List booking occurrences (one calendar entry per booked date) in a date-time window of at most 31 days. Recurring bookings give one occurrence per date. Returns one page with paging.cursor. Skedda API: GET /api/v1/booking-occurrences.

date_time_from.description: Window start, with a UTC offset, e.g. 2026-05-01T00:00:00+02:00.

date_time_to.description: Window end, same form. At most 31 days after date_time_from.

space_ids.description: Only occurrences in these space ids (up to 50).

holders.description: Only occurrences held by these venue-user ids (up to 50).

last_modified_time.description: Only bookings modified at or after this time (incremental sync).

cursor.description: paging.cursor of the previous page. Keep every other parameter unchanged.

expand.description: Comma-separated paths to return in full instead of ids, e.g. assignedTo. Up to 3 fields; nest with dots.

tools.name: skedda_get_booking_occurrence
tools.title: Get a booking occurrence
tools.description: Get one booking occurrence by its booking id and venue-local start date (the bookingId and the date part of start from a list item). Skedda API: GET /api/v1/booking/{bookingId}/occurrence/{date}.

booking_id.description: The bookingId of a list item.

date.description: Start date in the venue's time zone, yyyy-mm-dd (the date part of start).

expand.description: Comma-separated paths to return in full instead of ids, e.g. assignedTo. Up to 3 fields; nest with dots.
